title: Fix media safety and shutdown regressions
summary: Fail closed when source duration verification cannot run, preserve publish evidence for existing-output encode/remux skips, reject unsafe automatic MP4 image-subtitle burn decisions, correct Phase 07B subtitle stream mapping, make final-library promotion transactional across primary and sidecars, and require explicit confirmed force mode before Tauri can request active-work shutdown.
reason: Review found false-success and silent quality-loss risks in FFmpeg/ffprobe verification, existing-output fallback, MP4 image-subtitle decisioning, dry-run stream mapping, final-library promotion rollback, and Tauri backend shutdown intent.
behavior_before: Source duration probe failure could pass verification, existing-output encode/remux skips returned success without publish evidence, MP4 image subtitles were auto-burned by default, the plan executor used ffprobe stream indexes where subtitle ordinals or mkvmerge TIDs were required, final-library promotion could leave a copied primary after a later sidecar failure, and Tauri exit paths always sent force_active_work_shutdown=true.
behavior_after: Source duration probe failure fails verification, existing-output skips return complete published evidence, MP4 image subtitles reject/no-publish unless explicitly handled, text subtitle conversion remains allowed, FFmpeg subtitle burn uses subtitle ordinals, mkvmerge subtitle selection uses TIDs or fails closed, final-library promotion rolls back the whole multi-file reveal transaction on failure, and Tauri only sends force_active_work_shutdown=true after explicit unsafe-close confirmation.
